# ISV Landing Zone Foundation

Implements the baseline from Azure Cloud Adoption Framework ISV landing zone guidance.

## Focus areas

- Management group and subscription layout for platform and workloads.
- Connectivity and isolation design for multi-tenant SaaS.
- Identity/RBAC patterns for least-privilege operations.
- Policy, tagging, and governance controls.
- Baseline monitoring and security services.

## Deliverables

- Landing zone decision record.
- Foundation IaC checklist and deployment order.
- Environment promotion model for dev/test/prod.
